prompt: Blocks are 4 bytes. An inode lists the blocks of a file.

trace.label: A file of 10 bytes needs how many blocks?
An empty file (0 bytes) needs how many blocks?
Writing allocated 2 of the 3 blocks, then the disk ran full. The right cleanup is to
choices: keep the 2 blocks for next time

explain: Block count is the size divided by block size, rounded up: 10 / 4 -> 3. A failed write must not leak blocks, so it hands back what it already took.
